quote.text: The bravest sight in the world is to see a great man struggling against adversity.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace the natural imperfections of family life; much like a noble soul facing adversity, showing vulnerability teaches your children the true value of growth through struggle.
    • Remember that the struggle itself refines character—by witnessing your own efforts against hardships, your children learn the courage to face their own challenges with resilience.
  • Leadership
    • True leadership is revealed not in moments of ease, but in the courageous determination to overcome adversity; a leader who struggles sincerely inspires those who follow.
    • In every trial, the opportunity arises to display integrity and wisdom, reminding us that even great leaders must continuously cultivate strength and humility amid challenges.
  • Product Management
    • Every setback in product management is a crucible for innovation—struggles reveal where improvements are needed and invite creative problem-solving to transform adversity into progress.
    • Just as a great man’s deliberate struggle becomes a beacon of bravery, transparent acknowledgment of difficulties in product development inspires dynamic teamwork and resilient strategies.
